Focused raho; distraction mehngi padti hai.
Main fail nahi hua—bas 10,000 ways mil gaye jo work nahi karte.
"Tera goal bas thoda out of reach ho."
Hardships ordinary ko extraordinary destiny ke liye prepare karti.
Abhi action lo.
Self-mastery hi real power hai.
"Success banne nahi—value ka banao."
"Mind garden hai—thoughts seeds."
Baat chhoro, kaam shuru karo.
Failure ko teacher banao, boss nahi.
Dreams kaam nahi karte jab tak tum na karo.
"Soch bovo, action kaat lo."
Itna high aim karo jitna tum sochte ho usse bhi.
